items.title: ترامپ: محدود کردن دسترسی اوکراین به شبکه استارشیلد کار من نبود

items.summary_original: Pope Leo XIV called Russian President Vladimir Putin while recovering from surgery in the hospital to urge him to call a ceasefire in the city of Oleshky in Ukraine. "During the conversation, the Holy Father expressed his deep concern about the grave humanitarian situation in the city of Oleshky, in the Kherson region, and called for a ceasefire to allow the delivery of food and medical assistance and the voluntary and safe evacuation of the civilian population," the Vatican said in a statement. "Finally, the Holy Father reaffirmed the Holy See’s commitment to promoting dialogue and peace." TRUMP ANNOUNCES IMMEDIATE ENERGY CEASEFIRE BETWEEN RUSSIA AND UKRAINE The situation in Oleshky is dire with no humanitarian food deliveries allowed in the Russian-controlled city since May. It also has no electricity, gas or running water, and the hospital is barely functional. The pope was diagnosed with lung cancer Tuesday and underwent a procedure to remove the lower lobe of his right lung. The 71-year-old remained in the hospital recovering on Friday but seemed to be doing well. Along with the call, he held Mass in a makeshift hospital chapel, and the Vatican released the first images of him since his surgery, which showed him standing at an altar. It comes as her one-week tenure was marked by mounting scrutiny over her legal credentials and a rocky debut before the White House press corps on Tuesday. Critics have taken aim at Zacharia over her recent interviews attempting to recover from the bumpy start. Zacharia was named to the role Oct. 9 and stepped behind the White House podium for her first press briefing just days later on Oct. 13. The briefing lasted 14 minutes and Zacharia took only three questions. "Maybe it’s not for her," Trump acknowledged in his brief remarks outside the White House on Friday. items.summary_original: Texas Democratic Senate nominee James Talarico is facing lingering frustration from inside his own political backyard over the cancellation of an event that was supposed to take place on Oct. 5 with a Black civic-service group. The Central Texas African American Civic Engagement Symposium (CT-AACES) expressed deep frustration in an email, sent to the Talarico campaign and obtained by Fox News Digital, after the campaign cancelled an event – which had 325 confirmed registrants – during Talarico's two-week absence from the campaign trail due to illness. CT-AACES said the cancellation left them with "irrecoverable financial loss," and that Talarico's campaign had not engaged in rescheduling efforts "While we understand Representative Talarico’s health required priority, we are deeply disappointed by the campaign’s decision to issue a flat cancellation rather than committing to a rescheduled date," the email reads. "It was a missed opportunity for Representative Talarico to directly address community skepticism and demonstrate the sincerity of his commitment to Central Texas African Americans." The cancellation is the most recent instance of the tensions that Talarico's campaign has faced with the Black community. It also casts doubt on the effectiveness of his efforts to reach Black voteBlack voters through a $25 million outreach pledge aimed at mobilizing black voters is fully reaching the ground. items.summary_original: Americans interviewed by Fox News Digital were overwhelmingly pleased with President Donald Trump's decision to call off livestreaming the Fort Hood shooter’s planned firing squad execution after the Pentagon had announced it would be livestreamed for public viewing. "I'm really glad that he called it off, because I feel like it's not really a deterrent, it's more like a shock effect," Sylvia from Arizona told Fox News Digital. "I don't think we really need that in this country right now." "The only other countries that really do that are like North Korea," David from Arizona said. "We don't want to be North Korea." AMERICANS DRAW THE LINE AT LIVESTREAMING ‘SPECTACLE’ OF FORT HOOD SHOOTER'S EXECUTION: ‘IT’S AN ABOMINATION’ "I never approved of the idea of it being public in the first place," Nate from Virginia said. "I think it's just ridiculous to make a spectacle out of an execution, especially in 2026 of all time." Ilhan Omar , D-Minn., who is currently on a book tour promoting a memoir about her life as a Somali immigrant, skipped a scheduled event due to a "family emergency" amid the fallout from the raid on the congresswoman's home. As Omar faces a federal government probe related to potential immigration fraud as well as a separate investigation into her financial disclosures, Sahra Noor was scheduled for a book tour stop at the University of Minnesota Rochester on Thursday night. Noor, who came to the United States as a refugee alongside Omar and other family members in the 1990s, was reportedly subpoenaed in relation to the immigration investigation into her sister. She currently lives in Nairobi, Kenya, according to her LinkedIn page, but is on a worldwide book tour promoting her recently-released "Salt in the Snow: A Somali Immigrant Story." items.summary_original: Several high-profile Democratic lawmakers renewed calls for gun control after a teenager broke into an Oregon elementary school Thursday and fatally shot three children and a teacher before being killed by an armed bystander. Sen. Ron Wyden, who has represented Oregon in the Senate since 1996, made one of the most explicit calls for tighter gun laws following the shooting at Silver Rail Elementary School in Bend, where the 16-year-old attacker used his mother’s shotgun, according to The Associated Press. The case was brought by the League of Women Voters, the Electronic Privacy Information Center and the League of United Latin American Citizens and is the latest legal challenge to President Donald Trump's efforts to combat noncitizen voting. items.summary_original: A Nigerian man forced to cook thousands of meals for the Unknown Gunmen, a militant group linked to political violence in Nigeria, is at the center of a Supreme Court showdown that could determine how broadly immigration authorities can apply a terrorism-related bar to asylum and how far the Trump administration can go in deporting immigrants accused of supporting terrorism. items.summary: نیل گورسوچ، قاضی محافظه‌کار دادگاه عالی، با سونیا سوتومایور، قاضی لیبرال متحد شده است تا پیگرد قانونی یک مهاجر غیرقانونی توسط دولت فدرال را زیر سوال ببرد، که نشان‌دهنده آخرین اتحاد غیرمحتمل بین این دو قاضی است. گورسوش که توسط رئیس جمهور دونالد ترامپ منصوب شد و سوتومایور منصوب شده توسط رئیس جمهور سابق باراک اوباما، نگرانی های خود را در مورد تصمیم دولت برای محاکمه دوبار یک شهروند مکزیکی به دلیل یافتن غیرقانونی در ایالات متحده - حتی پس از اینکه دادگاه فدرال او را از خروج از ناحیه شرقی اوکلاهاما پس از اولین محکومیتش منع کرد، ایجاد کردند. این زوج نامحتمل روز سه‌شنبه زمانی پدیدار شد که دادگاه عالی از رسیدگی به درخواست تجدیدنظر عیسی هررا-سالازار، که استدلال می‌کرد دومین پیگرد قانونی او نقض قانون حمایت از متمم پنجم است، خودداری کرد.
items.summary_original: Conservative Supreme Court Justice Neil Gorsuch has joined forces with liberal Justice Sonia Sotomayor to question the federal government's prosecution of an illegal immigrant, marking the latest unlikely alliance between the two justices. Gorsuch, appointed by President Donald Trump, and Sotomayor, appointed by former President Barack Obama, raised concerns about the government's decision to prosecute a Mexican national twice for being found unlawfully in the United States — even after a federal court prohibited him from leaving the Eastern District of Oklahoma following his first conviction. The unlikely pairing emerged Tuesday when the Supreme Court declined to hear an appeal from Jesus Herrera-Salazar, who argued that his second prosecution violated the Fifth Amendment's protection against double jeopardy. Although the justices agreed the Court should not take up the case, Sotomayor issued a separate statement, joined by Gorsuch, warning of serious constitutional problems with the government's actions. Rioters in Tirana were seen throwing rocks at a police cordon outside Albania's Education Ministry, prompting law enforcement to respond with tear gas and water cannons, according to The Associated Press. The clashes followed riots on Wednesday when protesters attacked government buildings, banks and businesses, leaving 89 people injured, including 61 police officers. "As for calls for my resignation, governments are changed through democratic elections. We had elections last year, not a revolution," Albanian Prime Minister Edi Rama told Reuters on Thursday. ALBANIAN PROTESTERS FLOOD STREETS DEMANDING PRIME MINISTER'S RESIGNATION AMID CORRUPTION ACCUSATIONS "My responsibility is to listen, address legitimate concerns and keep Albania moving forward," he added. "The alternative would be a betrayal of the Albanians who gave me a strong mandate to complete negotiations on European Union membership." Thursday's protests included student groups seeking education reforms, as well as others staging a broader anti-government movement opposed to a major development project linked to President Donald Trump’s son-in-law, Jared Kushner, the AP reported. items.summary: به گفته یکی از رهبران جامعه یهودی که در جلسه حضور داشت، یک هتل دوبلین از میزبانی یک رویداد بین‌المللی با محوریت مبارزه با یهود ستیزی خودداری کرد و متعاقباً پس از اینکه مدیر کل آن سؤال کرد که آیا نیروهای دفاعی اسرائیل در این نشست شرکت خواهند کرد، تقریباً 70 اتاق را که برای نمایندگان اختصاص داده شده بود، خارج کرد. موریس کوهن، رئیس شورای نمایندگان یهودیان ایرلند، به فاکس نیوز دیجیتال گفت که او و یک سازمان دهنده رویداد در روز 7 مه با نمایندگان هتل هربرت پارک، از جمله مدیر کل آن، ملاقات کردند تا درباره گردهمایی توضیح دهند و درباره ترتیبات آن بحث کنند. این رویداد به کنفرانس نمایندگان و هماهنگ کنندگان ویژه مبارزه با یهودی ستیزی در این هفته مرتبط بود که رهبران یهودی، دیپلمات ها و مقامات دولتی مسئول مقابله با یهودی ستیزی را به این کنفرانس آورد.

items.summary: بی‌بی‌سی وریفای، بخش راستی‌آزمایی بی‌بی‌سی، صدها مورد را بررسی کرده که در آنها ارتش اسرائیل در سه سال گذشته به کشتن یا زخمی‌کردن افراد در غزه، کرانه باختری، لبنان و اسرائیل متهم شده و گفته است در حال بررسی آنهاست. این تحقیق نشان می‌دهد از میان ۳۰۰ پرونده شناسایی‌شده، تنها درباره ۲۸ مورد نتیجه‌ای به‌طور علنی منتشر شده و برای دست‌کم ۲۵۴ مورد نتیجه عمومی در دسترس نیست. در این مطلب، نحوه رسیدگی ارتش اسرائیل به این پرونده‌ها، دلایل طولانی‌شدن بعضی تحقیقات و نمونه‌هایی از حوادث مرگبار در غزه، کرانه باختری و لبنان بررسی شده است.

items.title_original: UN inquiry member says some genocide claims against Israel unverified as Gaza reports population growth
items.summary: اتهامات نسل کشی علیه اسرائیل در این هفته پس از اعتراف گزارش شده توسط یکی از اعضای ارشد کمیسیون تحقیق سازمان ملل درباره اسرائیل مبنی بر اینکه ادعاها به طور مستقل تأیید نشده اند، بیشتر مورد توجه قرار گرفت. این در حالی است که داده های وزارت بهداشت فلسطین نشان می دهد که جمعیت غزه در سال 2025 افزایش یافته است. منتقدان می گویند این اتهامات به یهودی ستیزی در سراسر جهان دامن می زند و کسانی که ادعاهای نسل کشی را مطرح می کنند - از جمله رسانه های بزرگ بین المللی - باید در قبال سخنان خود پاسخگو باشند. در سپتامبر 2025، کمیسیون مستقل بین المللی تحقیق در مورد اراضی اشغالی فلسطین، از جمله بیت المقدس شرقی و اسرائیل (COI) گزارشی را منتشر کرد که در آن بیان داشت اسرائیل از اکتبر 2023 در غزه نسل کشی کرده است. در این گزارش، COI به مقاله ای از Guar استناد کرد.

items.summary: نایب بوکله، رئیس‌جمهور سالوادور، طرحی را ارائه کرده است که می‌تواند به آزادی مشروط پیش از موعد نیمی از بازداشت‌شدگان در شرایط اضطراری که مقامات برای دستگیری بیش از 90000 نفر در چهار سال و نیم گذشته به‌عنوان بخشی از تلاش‌ها برای مهار فعالیت باندهای جنایتکار خشونت‌آمیز استفاده کرده‌اند، اجازه دهد. برنامه بوکله برای کاهش جمعیت زندان ها سه شنبه شب اعلام شد. این برنامه بر آزادی زندانیانی تمرکز دارد که به عنوان همکار باند شناخته می‌شوند، یک اصطلاح گسترده که می‌تواند شامل افراد مختلف، از جمله دیده‌بانان باند و کسانی باشد که پرداخت‌های اخاذی انجام می‌دهند. بوکله گفت: «افراد زیادی هستند که واقعاً مرتکب جنایات شده‌اند، اما جرم آنها همکاری با باندها بود. او گفت: «آنها مستحق زندان هستند، اما ما از کشوری آمده‌ایم که در آن همکاری با باندها چندان غیرعادی نبود.
items.summary_original: Salvadoran President Nayib Bukele has unveiled a plan that could allow the conditional early release of up to half of those detained under a state of emergency that authorities used to arrest more than 90,000 people in the past four and a half years as part of an effort to curb violent criminal gang activity. Bukele's plan to cut the prison population was announced on Tuesday night. It would focus on freeing prisoners who were deemed gang collaborators, a broad term that can include various people, including gang lookouts and those who make extortion payments. "There are many people who have indeed committed crimes, but their crime was collaborating with gangs," Bukele said. "They deserve to be in jail, but we come from a country where collaborating with gangs wasn’t so unusual, and if we were to arrest everyone who collaborated with gangs, we would have to arrest 20% of the population." Without offering details, the president indicated that authorities plan to analyze cases to determine potential early release with monitoring, which could apply to half of the people detained during the state of emergency. items.title_original: Trump wishes Pope Leo speedy recovery after lung cancer diagnosis, speaks highly of pontiff's brother
items.summary: دونالد ترامپ، رئیس‌جمهور آمریکا روز چهارشنبه پس از تشخیص سرطان ریه پاپ لئو چهاردهم، آرزوی بهبودی سریع کرد و فاش کرد که با برادر پاپ دوست است که او را حامی مشتاق MAGA توصیف کرد. ترامپ هنگام سفر از آریزونا به مونتانا در عرشه ایر فورس وان با خبرنگاران درباره بهبودی پاپ 71 ساله پس از عمل جراحی برای برداشتن بخشی از ریه راست ابراز خوش بینی کرد. رئیس جمهور گفت: "من می خواهم ببینم پاپ لئو خوب می شود. من پیش آگهی این نوع مشکل را می شنوم. این یک سرطان است. این چیز بزرگی است. هر زمان که سرطان داشته باشید." "اما به نظر می رسد که پیش آگهی خوب است، من تماشا کرده ام. و ما فقط می خواهیم برای او عشق و بهترین آرزوهایمان را آرزو کنیم." پاپ لئو چهاردهم دیدار تاریخی 4 روزه از فرانسه را آغاز کرد ترامپ سپس درباره دوستی خود با برادر پاپ صحبت کرد.
items.summary_original: President Donald Trump wished Pope Leo XIV a speedy recovery Wednesday following his lung cancer diagnosis, revealing that he is friends with the pontiff's brother, whom he described as an enthusiastic MAGA supporter. Speaking to reporters aboard Air Force One while traveling from Arizona to Montana, Trump expressed optimism about the 71-year-old pontiff's recovery following surgery to remove part of his right lung. "I want to see Pope Leo get well. I hear the prognosis for that type of a problem. It's a cancer. It's big stuff. Anytime you have cancer," the president said. "But the prognosis seems to be good, I've watched. And we just want to wish him our love and our best wishes." POPE LEO XIV BEGINS HISTORIC 4-DAY VISIT TO FRANCE Trump then discussed his friendship with the pope's brother and his wife, describing them as enthusiastic supporters of the president. "His brother is a friend of mine, who's a great — he's a fantastic guy — and his wife. You know, they're big Trump supporters. They have MAGA all over their house," he continued. "And I can say that his brother loves him a lot. Loves the pope a lot, and that's good, but I just want to wish him well. Get better fast." The president's remarks came one day after the Vatican announced that Leo had been diagnosed with lung adenocarcinoma, a form of lung cancer, following surgery at Agostino Gemelli University Hospital in Rome. items.title_original: Woman found floating in sea after going overboard from Royal Caribbean ship
items.summary: گارد ساحلی یونان اعلام کرد زنی که از یک کشتی تفریحی رویال کارائیب به دریا رفته بود، پس از 20 ساعت گذراندن در آب و چسبیدن به شناور نجات نجات یافت. وزارت امور خارجه یونان به یو اس ای تودی گفت که این شهروند 44 ساله سالوادور در حال سفر به کشتی اودیسه دریاها بود که روز شنبه در دریای ایونی نزدیک جزیره زاکینتوس حرکت می کرد. کشتی باری MSC Rossella III به جستجو کمک می کرد و زن را در داخل شناور نجات نارنجی روشن در آب های تاریک مشاهده کرد. کشتی به مقامات هشدار داد و یک خدمه گارد ساحلی یونان وارد شدند تا طناب های او را پرتاب کنند و او را به محل امن بکشند. مسافر کروز از بالکن می پرد و پس از سقوط به داخل اقیانوس جان خود را از دست می دهد.
items.summary_original: A woman who went overboard from a Royal Caribbean cruise ship was rescued after spending 20 hours in the water clinging to a lifebuoy, the Hellenic Coast Guard said. The 44-year-old Salvadoran national was traveling aboard Odyssey of the Seas as it sailed through the Ionian Sea near the island of Zakynthos on Saturday, the Greek Ministry of Foreign Affairs told USA Today. The cargo ship MSC Rossella III was assisting in the search and spotted the woman inside the bright orange lifebuoy in dark waters. Leo, the first American pope, shared his opposition to capital punishment Saturday in a social media post marking World Day Against the Death Penalty. Citing Catholic doctrine revised under his predecessor, Pope Francis, Leo emphasized that the death penalty violates human dignity. "The death penalty is inadmissible because it is an attack on the inviolability and dignity of the person. The common good can be safeguarded and the requirements of justice can be met without recourse to capital punishment: effective systems of detention have been developed that protect citizens while at the same time do not completely deprive those who are guilty of the possibility of redemption," Leo wrote on X. "#NoDeathPenalty," he added in the post. items.summary_original: At least 139 migrants, including 15 children, died when a boat carrying more than 300 people capsized off the coast of Djibouti, according to the United Nations' migration agency. The vessel was carrying 305 people from Djibouti toward Yemen when it capsized Thursday night or early Friday near Guhere, north of Obock, the International Organization for Migration (IOM) said Sunday. At least 84 people remained missing as of Sunday, while more than 80 survived. All the survivors were Ethiopian nationals , according to the agency. "No one gets into a boat like that unless they believe there is no other safe way," IOM Director General Amy Pope said in a statement. items.summary_original: President Donald Trump's efforts to reach a diesel agreement with Russia could provide Russian President Vladimir Putin with fresh revenue to fund his war against Ukraine while allowing Moscow to buy time through negotiations it has little intention of honoring, a former NATO commander warned Sunday. Retired Gen. Philip Breedlove , former NATO supreme allied commander Europe and head of U.S. European Command, told Fox News Digital that Washington also risks undermining Ukraine's war effort by striking a deal with what he called "the enemy." "And so we are cutting a deal with the enemy," Breedlove said, warning that "all of this money will go into fueling Mr. Putin's continued attacks in Ukraine." The Russian government said Saturday it had partially lifted a ban on diesel exports with immediate effect, following the new agreement between Putin and Trump for Russia to supply the U.S. and global markets, Reuters reported. As previously reported by Fox News Digital, Trump's package calls for the release of 300,000 tonnes of diesel "to the American and global marketplace," followed by 500,000 tonnes in November and another 1 million tonnes afterward. items.summary_original: Iranian Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei claimed Oct. 8 that U.S. and Israeli strikes had failed to undermine Iran's domestic security forces, praising police personnel for resisting attacks launched in February under Operations Epic Fury and Roaring Lion. Khamenei's remarks on X also came as the U.S. Army released a new battlefield identification guide to help American troops recognize members of Iran's conventional military, known as the Artesh, whose ground forces were estimated by the Jerusalem Institute for Strategy and Security in June at 350,000 personnel. "The criminal US-Zionist enemy's desperate efforts and malicious attacks on the pillars of social order and security, which are unparalleled throughout history, have not caused the courageous personnel of the Police Force to waver even a fraction in their mission," Khamenei wrote in a statement. Khamenei specifically praised Iran's Law Enforcement Command, known as FARAJA, accusing the United States and Israel of targeting the institution responsible for maintaining domestic order. "The focus and persistence of the criminal US-Zionist enemy in striking at the Police Force at its various levels, from its highest command levels down to those who are on the frontline, has only served to underscore the paramount importance of this institution more than ever," he wrote. items.summary: محمود عباس، رئیس تشکیلات خودگردان فلسطین، بیش از دو دهه پس از انتخاب شدن برای دوره ای چهار ساله، بار دیگر انتخابات را به تعویق انداخت و انتظار نزدیک به 20 ساله رای دهندگان برای انتخاب مجلس جدید را تمدید کرد. به گزارش خبرگزاری رسمی فلسطین وفا، عباس روز جمعه با صدور فرمانی، انتخابات شورای قانونگذاری فلسطین را از ماه آینده تا 11 سپتامبر 2027 به تعویق انداخت. انتخابات ریاست جمهوری که از زمان پیروزی عباس در سال 2005 تاکنون برگزار نشده است نیز در آن تاریخ برنامه ریزی شده است. این تأخیر به رهبران فلسطینی اجازه می دهد تا بدون رویارویی با رای دهندگان در قدرت باقی بمانند و می تواند اعتبار تشکیلات خودگردان فلسطین را که به دلیل فساد و همکاری امنیتی خود با اسرائیل با انتقاداتی روبرو شده است، آسیب بیشتری وارد کند. اورتگا نیکاراگوئه می‌گوید این کشور هرگز A نخواهد کرد
items.summary_original: More than two decades after being elected to what was supposed to be a four-year term, Palestinian Authority President Mahmoud Abbas has once again postponed elections, extending a nearly 20-year wait for voters to choose a new legislature. Abbas issued a decree Friday pushing Palestinian Legislative Council elections from next month to Sept. 11, 2027, according to the official Palestinian news agency WAFA. Presidential elections , which have not been held since Abbas' 2005 victory, are also scheduled for that date. The delay allows Palestinian leaders to remain in power without facing voters and could further damage the credibility of the Palestinian Authority, which has faced criticism over corruption and its security cooperation with Israel. NICARAGUA'S ORTEGA SAYS COUNTRY WILL 'NEVER AGAIN' HOLD ELECTIONS, SHUTTING OUT OPPOSITION The Palestinian Authority, dominated by Abbas' Fatah party, governs parts of the West Bank under agreements reached in the 1990s. Palestinian officials cited conditions in the West Bank, Gaza Strip and east Jerusalem as reasons for postponing the vote. The Palestine Liberation Organization's Executive Committee, which Abbas heads, claimed Israel had blocked election materials and international observers from entering Gaza, according to The Associated Press. items.title: بی‌طرفی، راستی‌آزمایی و پاسخ‌گویی؛ چرا بی‌بی‌سی فارسی بر این اصول ایستادگی می‌کند؟
items.summary: این مطلب توضیح می‌دهد که چرا بی‌بی‌سی فارسی در یکی از پرتنش‌ترین دوره‌های تاریخ معاصر ایران بر اصول بنیادین روزنامه‌نگاری، از جمله بی‌طرفی، راستی‌آزمایی، استقلال تحریریه و پاسخ‌گویی، پافشاری می‌کند. در این مقاله، با مرور شیوه تصمیم‌گیری‌های تحریریه، فرآیند راستی‌آزمایی اخبار، نحوه انتخاب مهمانان و برخورد با خطاها و انتقادها، تشریح می‌شود که هدف بی‌بی‌سی نه جانبداری از هیچ طرف، بلکه ارائه گزارشی دقیق، مستقل و مبتنی بر شواهد است تا مخاطبان بتوانند بر اساس اطلاعات قابل اعتماد، خود درباره رویدادها قضاوت کنند.

items.summary: با گذشت چهل سال از آغاز جنگ ایران و عراق، هنوز اطلاعات مرتبط با مقاطع مهمی از جنگ، از آرشیوهای محرمانه خارج نشده است. یکی از جلسات مهمی که در آن فرماندهی جنگ مورد انتقاد سپاهیان ناراضی قرار می‌گیرد، اوایل آذر ۶۳ برگزار می‌شود که در دهه‌های اخیر، رسانه‌های حکومتی ایران روایت‌های پراکنده و به‌شدت تحریف شده‌ای را از آن منتشر کرده‌اند.
